method: Batch 88 (mobrec88): the batch 47 serverplayer harness (the probe player a ticked EntityPlayerMP: EntityPlayerMP.onUpdateEntity after the world tick runs its potion effects; the hurt-window and respawn counters of EntityPlayerMP.onUpdate, mw.h, count down after the mobs) where every EntityThrowable (the snow golem snowballs) updates after the mobs in spawn order. Rows as b47sp plus row element 9 [[throwable index, x, y, z, motion x, y, z, dead] for each one that updated, [the player active effects [id, duration, amplifier]]]; a spider and cave spider row has entityToAttack (td.bT) as its target; row element 5[1] lists a new snowball as [snowball, x, y, z, motion, Entity.rand seed] after its first update. cave-*: a cave spider bites the player at night (Normal, Hard, Easy, creative after the bite), the player kills it at tick 61 and the poison runs out; golem-*: an iron golem against a creeper, a spider and a cave spider; snow-*: a snow golem against a zombie and a creeper, the player 55 blocks away. Unchanged classes on the VillageLiveProbe double (no village), the player a real EntityPlayerMP (ServerPlayerProbe), every mob ticked by Entity.onUpdate. Per tick: [mob rows [x,y,z,health,target index,revenge index,flags,draws], sounds, player health lost, player revenge index, player ticks]; the player has index types.length. See EndermanWolfProbe.java for types and script ops.
